evidence.quote: The programme is taught in English on a full-time basis.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: all countries 8,200 EUR
Application Deadline 30 June 2027 Start Date 1 September 2027
English language skills B2 required, proof via placement test/interview
As we have incorporated an English language test into our Assessment Centre, you are not required to submit an English certificate with your application.

note.fr: L'admission exige de réussir un Assessment Centre en ligne : test de mathématiques, test cognitif, test d'anglais et entretien.
note.en: Admission requires passing an online Assessment Centre: mathematics test, cognitive test, English test and interview.

evidence.quote: The Assessment Centre, which includes a mathematics test, a cognitive test, an English test and an interview.

note.fr: Les candidats qui ne remplissent pas les conditions générales d'admission peuvent peut-être postuler en vertu d'une récente modification de la loi allemande; contacter l'école.
note.en: Applicants who do not meet the general admission requirements may still be eligible to apply under a recent change in German law; contact the school.

evidence.quote: If you do not meet the general admission requirements, you may still be eligible to apply under a recent change in German law.

notes: No page states the application channel (uni-assist, VPD or the university's own portal) for international applicants to this Bachelor's programme, so applicationChannel and documents were left out. One intakes value is reported, from the programme's own page (30 June 2027 deadline, 1 September 2027 start); it is written as the programme's application deadline, not a sentence said to be specifically for non-EU or foreign-qualification applicants. Tuition: only the DAAD all-countries figure of 8,200 EUR per semester could be quoted for an out-of-EU applicant; the programme's own page gives € 8,600/semester but that sentence does not explicitly say it applies to non-EU students, so it was not used as the value.
